The '''daughter''' of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Winstel Greelanx]] was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who was an adult and [[Marriage/Legends|married]]<ref name="The Hutt Gambit" /> by around [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Greelanx loved his daughter. Consequently, when he feared retribution in the event that his deliberate defeat at the [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (4 BBY)|Battle of Nar Shaddaa]] be uncovered, he dismissed the idea of fleeing to save himself because that course of action would have likely resulted in his family's [[Death/Legends|deaths]].<ref name="The Hutt Gambit" />
